<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>
      Crunchbase | Private Company Data & Predictive Intelligence
    </title>
    <meta
      name="description"
      content="Discover private company data, funding insights, and AI-powered predictions with Crunchbase."
    />
    <style>
      @font-face {
        font-family: "Public Sans";
        font-style: normal;
        font-weight: 300 800;
        font-display: swap;
        src: url("/assets/static/static-pages/public-sans-latin.woff2")
          format("woff2");
      }

      :root {
        --ink: #102b38;
        --ink-deep: #071f2a;
        --ink-card: #08232f;
        --paper: #ffffff;
        --mist: #f2f7fb;
        --line: #dce6ed;
        --blue: #146aff;
        --blue-bright: #2877ff;
        --cta-light-blue: #d5edff;
        --cta-light-blue-hover: #bfe3ff;
        --cta-light-blue-active: #a9d9ff;
        --lilac: #d7c7ff;
        --muted: #b9c9d0;
        --upsell-background: #fad391;
        --upsell-active: #f8c165;
        --upsell-focus-border: 2px solid #fce4bd;
        --upsell-hover-shadow: 0 2px 4px 0 #cbd8df;
        --max: 1180px;
      }

      *,
      *::before,
      *::after {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      html {
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
      }

      body {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--paper);
        font-family: "Public Sans", Arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 16px;
        line-height: 1.5;
      }

      a {
        color: inherit;
      }

      a:focus-visible,
      button:focus-visible,
      input:focus-visible + label {
        outline: 3px solid #78a7ff;
        outline-offset: 4px;
      }

      .sr-only {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        padding: 0;
        margin: -1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
        white-space: nowrap;
        border: 0;
      }

      .container {
        width: min(calc(100% - 48px), var(--max));
        margin-inline: auto;
      }

      .dark-shell {
        color: var(--paper);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at 82% 13%, #123e51 0, transparent 26rem),
          var(--ink);
      }

      .site-header {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 10;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        anchor-name: --static-homepage-header;
      }

      .nav {
        min-height: 68px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 28px;
      }

      .brand {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .brand-logo {
        display: block;
        width: 110px;
        height: auto;
      }

      .nav-links {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 24px;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
      }

      .nav-links > li {
        position: relative;
      }

      .nav-links > li > a {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: normal;
      }

      .nav-links a,
      .nav-dropdown-trigger,
      .nav-login {
        color: #d9e4e8;
        font-size: 13px;
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .nav-links a:hover,
      .nav-dropdown-trigger:hover,
      .nav-links
        > li:has(> .nav-dropdown-panel:popover-open)
        .nav-dropdown-trigger,
      .nav-login:hover {
        color: var(--paper);
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 7px;
        padding: 0;
        font-family: inherit;
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger-solutions {
        anchor-name: --nav-solutions-trigger;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger-products {
        anchor-name: --nav-products-trigger;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger-resources {
        anchor-name: --nav-resources-trigger;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger::after {
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
        margin-top: -3px;
        border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor;
        border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor;
        content: "";
        transform: rotate(45deg);
        transition: transform 140ms ease;
      }

      .nav-links
        > li:has(> .nav-dropdown-panel:popover-open)
        .nav-dropdown-trigger::after {
        margin-top: 3px;
        transform: rotate(225deg);
      }

      .nav-dropdown-trigger:focus-visible {
        border-radius: 2px;
        outline: 3px solid #78a7ff;
        outline-offset: 4px;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel {
        position: fixed;
        inset: auto;
        top: 76px;
        left: 50%;
        display: none;
        width: 280px;
        max-height: calc(100dvh - 84px);
        gap: 4px;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 12px;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--paper);
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 10px;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(2, 20, 29, 0.24);
        list-style: none;
        overflow-y: auto;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel:popover-open {
        display: grid;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel a {
        display: grid;
        gap: 2px;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        color: var(--ink);
        border-radius: 6px;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel a:hover,
      .nav-dropdown-panel a:focus-visible {
        color: var(--ink-deep);
        background: var(--mist);
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel strong {
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel span {
        color: #526975;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.35;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel-solutions {
        width: 330px;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel-resources {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        width: 430px;
      }

      .nav-dropdown-panel::backdrop {
        background: transparent;
      }

      @supports (top: anchor(--static-homepage-header bottom)) {
        .nav-dropdown-panel {
          top: calc(anchor(--static-homepage-header bottom) + 8px);
          transform: none;
        }

        .nav-dropdown-panel-solutions {
          left: calc(anchor(--nav-solutions-trigger left) - 20px);
        }

        .nav-dropdown-panel-products {
          left: calc(anchor(--nav-products-trigger left) - 20px);
        }

        .nav-dropdown-panel-resources {
          left: calc(anchor(--nav-resources-trigger center) - 215px);
        }
      }

      .nav-actions {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 16px;
        margin-left: auto;
      }

      .nav-search {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
      }

      .nav-search input {
        width: 0;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: 8px 0;
        color: var(--paper);
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
        opacity: 0;
        transition:
          width 160ms ease,
          opacity 160ms ease,
          padding 160ms ease;
      }

      .nav-search input:focus {
        width: 150px;
        padding-inline: 8px;
        border-color: #7893a0;
        opacity: 1;
        outline: 0;
      }

      .nav-search button {
        width: 34px;
        height: 34px;
        padding: 7px;
        color: var(--paper);
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 6px;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      .nav-search svg {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        fill: none;
        stroke: currentColor;
        stroke-width: 1.8;
      }

      .button {
        display: inline-flex;
        min-height: 42px;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 0 18px;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-family: "Public Sans", Arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 500;
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .button-primary {
        color: var(--paper);
        background: var(--blue);
      }

      .button-secondary {
        color: var(--paper);
        background: transparent;
        border-color: #81939b;
      }

      .button-light {
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--paper);
      }

      .hero-secondary-cta {
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--cta-light-blue);
      }

      .hero-secondary-cta:hover {
        background: var(--cta-light-blue-hover);
      }

      .hero-secondary-cta:active {
        background: var(--cta-light-blue-active);
      }

      .trial-cta {
        color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.87);
        background: var(--upsell-background);
      }

      .trial-cta:hover {
        background: var(--upsell-background);
        box-shadow: var(--upsell-hover-shadow);
      }

      .trial-cta:focus-visible {
        background: var(--upsell-background);
        outline: var(--upsell-focus-border);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }

      .trial-cta:active {
        background: var(--upsell-active);
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      .hero {
        min-height: 490px;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(340px, 0.95fr);
        align-items: center;
        gap: clamp(48px, 8vw, 112px);
        padding-block: 82px 96px;
      }

      .hero h1 {
        max-width: 630px;
        margin: 0;
        font-size: clamp(43px, 5.3vw, 72px);
        font-weight: 350;
        letter-spacing: -0.045em;
        line-height: 1.04;
      }

      .hero-copy > p {
        max-width: 610px;
        margin: 25px 0 27px;
        color: #d4e0e5;
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      .hero-search {
        display: flex;
        width: min(100%, 610px);
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        padding: 6px;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--paper);
        border: 1px solid #8ab5ff;
        border-radius: 10px;
        box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0, 8, 16, 0.24);
      }

      .hero-search:focus-within {
        outline: 3px solid #8ab5ff;
        outline-offset: 3px;
      }

      .hero-search-icon {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        margin-left: 10px;
        fill: none;
        stroke: #526975;
        stroke-width: 1.8;
      }

      .hero-search-field {
        position: relative;
        min-width: 0;
        flex: 1;
      }

      .hero-search input {
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: 12px 4px;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        font: inherit;
        font-size: 17px;
        outline: 0;
      }

      .hero-search input::placeholder {
        color: transparent;
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .hero-search input:focus::placeholder {
        color: #526975;
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .hero-search-prompts {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        color: #526975;
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: opacity 160ms ease;
      }

      .hero-search-prompt {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        right: 0;
        left: 4px;
        overflow: hidden;
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        animation: hero-search-prompt-cycle 18s infinite;
        font-size: 17px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .hero-search-prompt:first-child {
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .hero-search-prompt:nth-child(2) {
        animation-delay: 3s;
      }

      .hero-search-prompt:nth-child(3) {
        animation-delay: 6s;
      }

      .hero-search-prompt:nth-child(4) {
        animation-delay: 9s;
      }

      .hero-search-prompt:nth-child(5) {
        animation-delay: 12s;
      }

      .hero-search-prompt:nth-child(6) {
        animation-delay: 15s;
      }

      .hero-search:focus-within .hero-search-prompts,
      .hero-search input:not(:placeholder-shown) + .hero-search-prompts {
        opacity: 0;
      }

      @keyframes hero-search-prompt-cycle {
        0%,
        13.5% {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        16.67%,
        100% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(calc(-50% - 4px));
        }
      }

      .hero-search button {
        min-height: 48px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        padding-inline: 22px;
        color: var(--paper);
        background: var(--blue);
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font: inherit;
        font-size: 15px;
        font-weight: 700;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      .hero-search button:hover {
        background: #0057dc;
      }

      .hero-actions {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 12px;
      }

      .signal-board {
        position: relative;
        padding: 32px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(106, 144, 160, 0.24);
        border-radius: 10px;
        background:
          linear-gradient(rgba(52, 90, 106, 0.13) 1px, transparent 1px),
          linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(52, 90, 106, 0.13) 1px, transparent 1px),
          rgba(4, 28, 39, 0.55);
        background-size: 32px 32px;
      }

      .signal-label {
        margin: 0 0 12px 3px;
        color: #d9e4e8;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.16em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .signal-card {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        margin-top: 13px;
        padding: 11px 13px;
        color: #dbe7eb;
        border: 1px solid #214757;
        border-radius: 5px;
        background: rgba(6, 33, 44, 0.92);
        font-size: 13px;
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .signal-card:first-of-type {
        border-color: #2877ff;
        box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(20, 106, 255, 0.58);
      }

      .signal-card.signal-fade {
        opacity: 0.28;
        transform: scale(0.96);
      }

      .signal-card.signal-fade:last-child {
        opacity: 0.12;
        transform: scale(0.92);
      }

      .signal-card.signal-fade:focus-visible {
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .signal-logo {
        width: 34px;
        height: 34px;
        object-fit: contain;
        border: 1px solid #31505e;
        border-radius: 5px;
        background: var(--paper);
      }

      .signal-company {
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .signal-company strong,
      .signal-company span {
        display: block;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .signal-company span {
        color: #9cb0b9;
        font-size: 10px;
      }

      .signal-value {
        max-width: 155px;
        color: #c7d4d9;
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-align: right;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .signal-value small {
        display: block;
        color: #7f98a3;
        font-size: 8px;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      }

      .section-intro {
        max-width: 720px;
        margin-inline: auto;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .section-intro h2 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: clamp(34px, 4vw, 51px);
        font-weight: 350;
        letter-spacing: -0.035em;
        line-height: 1.08;
      }

      .section-intro p {
        margin: 18px 0 0;
        color: var(--muted);
      }

      .data-pillars {
        padding-block: 28px 128px;
      }

      .pillar-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 24px;
        margin-top: 52px;
      }

      .pillar {
        min-height: 222px;
        padding: 27px;
        border: 1px solid #214653;
        border-radius: 7px;
        background: rgba(5, 30, 41, 0.78);
      }

      .pillar-icon {
        display: grid;
        width: 34px;
        height: 34px;
        place-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        color: var(--lilac);
        font-size: 24px;
      }

      .pillar-icon svg {
        width: 34px;
        height: 34px;
      }

      .pillar h3 {
        margin: 0 0 14px;
        font-size: 17px;
        font-weight: 650;
      }

      .pillar p {
        margin: 0;
        color: #c0d0d6;
        font-size: 14px;
      }

      .prediction-section {
        padding-bottom: 112px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .prediction-section .section-intro {
        max-width: 862px;
      }

      .prediction-section .section-intro h2 {
        font-size: clamp(38px, 4.3vw, 53px);
      }

      .prediction-section .section-intro p {
        max-width: 760px;
        margin-inline: auto;
        font-size: 20px;
      }

      .prediction-marquee {
        --prediction-fade: clamp(24px, 5vw, 72px);
        width: min(calc(100% - 48px), 1357px);
        margin-top: 52px;
        margin-inline: auto;
        padding-block: 4px;
        overflow-x: auto;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
          to right,
          transparent,
          #000 var(--prediction-fade),
          #000 calc(100% - var(--prediction-fade)),
          transparent
        );
        mask-image: linear-gradient(
          to right,
          transparent,
          #000 var(--prediction-fade),
          #000 calc(100% - var(--prediction-fade)),
          transparent
        );
      }

      .prediction-marquee::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
      }

      .prediction-track {
        display: flex;
        width: max-content;
        animation: prediction-marquee 30s linear infinite;
        will-change: transform;
      }

      .prediction-marquee:hover .prediction-track,
      .prediction-marquee:focus-within .prediction-track {
        animation-play-state: paused;
      }

      .prediction-marquee:focus-within {
        -webkit-mask-image: none;
        mask-image: none;
      }

      .prediction-group {
        display: flex;
        flex: none;
        gap: 36px;
        padding-right: 36px;
      }

      .prediction-card {
        position: relative;
        width: 196px;
        height: 178px;
        flex: none;
        color: var(--paper);
        border: 1px solid #214653;
        border-radius: 7px;
        background: rgba(5, 30, 41, 0.78);
        outline: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .prediction-card:focus-visible {
        outline: 3px solid #78a7ff;
        outline-offset: 3px;
      }

      .prediction-face {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 18px;
        text-align: center;
        transition:
          opacity 300ms ease,
          transform 300ms ease;
      }

      .prediction-front {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 17px;
      }

      .prediction-front svg {
        display: block;
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        flex: none;
      }

      .prediction-front h3 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 18px;
        font-weight: 650;
        line-height: 1.2;
      }

      .prediction-back {
        background: var(--blue);
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-10%);
      }

      .prediction-card:nth-child(4n + 3) .prediction-back,
      .prediction-card:nth-child(4n + 4) .prediction-back {
        transform: translateY(10%);
      }

      .prediction-back p {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 14px;
        line-height: 1.45;
      }

      .prediction-card:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .prediction-front {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10%);
      }

      .prediction-card:nth-child(4n + 3):is(:hover, :focus-visible)
        .prediction-front,
      .prediction-card:nth-child(4n + 4):is(:hover, :focus-visible)
        .prediction-front {
        transform: translateY(-10%);
      }

      .prediction-card:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .prediction-back {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }

      @keyframes prediction-marquee {
        to {
          transform: translateX(-50%);
        }
      }

      .section-divider {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
      }

      .section-divider--reversed {
        transform: scaleY(-1);
      }

      .metrics {
        padding: 12px 0 86px;
      }

      .metrics-panel {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1.2fr repeat(2, 1fr);
        padding: 38px 42px;
        border: 1px solid #e3ebf0;
        border-radius: 7px;
        background: var(--mist);
      }

      .metrics-copy {
